oil.when: 2006–2009 with the MENU and ENTER buttons for the Driver Information Center
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Press MENU once so the display shows Oil Life Reset.
Press and hold ENTER for at least one second.
An Acknowledged message shows for about three seconds when the oil life has been reset to 100%.
oil.note: Checked in the 2006 and 2009 Getting to Know Your G6 guides.
